title: container-indexer-qol
description: Hover an item and press a key to make indexed nearby containers containing it emit particles.
body:
Container Indexer is a client-side QoL mod for NeoForge 1.21.1.

After you open and close containers, the mod records their contents locally. Press X while hovering an item, and nearby indexed containers containing that item will emit particles.

It helps players find stored items without opening every chest one by one.
